finding: Two exact locally consistent 12-ray spoke configurations of the positive 4D core's complementary G6 each force nine more rays, and neither forced 21-ray partial configuration extends, even with arbitrary symmetry breaking and repeated nonincident future rays. Exact triangle rigidity, a complete two-branch 12-cycle transfer, and a negative local operator-Hall determinant certify the exclusion; compactness supplies positive-radius excluded neighborhoods. All claims remain unreviewed.
remaining_gap: These are two specific 12-ray orbits and open neighborhoods, not all possible spokes or unrestricted C6 realizations; alternative 4D cores and irreducible 10D cores are also open. A 75-ray core lift would still leave 25 QLS cells and a complete resolution.
next_action: Investigate whether fewer fixed spokes or a broader free-parameter spoke family already force a similar phase-transfer/operator obstruction, or whether a symmetry-breaking partial can yield a constructive C6 lift.
